The board leans bear and sits at setup, a couple of conditions short of the rung that would force action. What is already in place is the right kind of evidence: credit widening, HYG off its high, the haven filter confirming, breadth narrowing at the index high.

What is missing is the slow-moving regime piece, financial conditions have not yet printed loose enough, and the closest-to-firing cluster around JPY, contango and credit-equity correlation has not completed. It becomes a trade when one of those slow pieces flips and the named setups actually cross their bars together.

It dies if HYG rallies back, credit spreads tighten, or the haven filter loses its confirmation, any one of those pulls the floor out from under the bear case.

Four rungs, and you only act on the top one. STAND DOWN, nothing is on. WATCH, one or two signals are true but they stand alone. SETUP, several are lining up. ACT, three of them have held for three sessions and they come from three different families, so it is not the same idea counted three times. A signal only counts once it has held three sessions, because one day in the zone is noise. Signals our lab rejected are left out of the count.
The three counts: firing = the condition is true at today's close, confirmed = it has been true 3 sessions in a row (this is what the bar counts), building = not true yet but close.
How to read each row: every signal is a checklist. Most of them need several things to be true at the same moment, so each line shows the condition, where it stands now and what it needs. A signal fires only when every box is ticked, which is why a number can sit well past its own trigger while the row still reads BUILDING. Some signals have two paths, either one arms them. ALERT (red bear / green bull) = it just fired, BUILDING = getting close, QUIET = nothing here yet. Widening? tells you whether the divergence is still growing or easing back. AI read

Index pressed against its high while fewer stocks tag new highs is the classic breadth fade, the rally narrowing to a handful of leaders. Both conditions are in place and nothing is missing, so the signal is firing on day one.

What kills it is a fresh surge in new highs that catches up to the index, or SPX pulling back enough that proximity to the high drops out. Until one of those happens, treat strength as being carried by fewer and fewer shoulders.

Statuses recompute nightly from the EOD pipeline. Confirmed = 3 consecutive sessions in zone (the framework buffer rule: one day in zone is noise). In formation = consecutive sessions spent in the top quintile of the metric. Sources: Polygon cache, nightly signal history tables, Yahoo for index series, FRED for macro.
